ruleDefinitions.name: PUA - NSudo Execution
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects the use of NSudo tool for command execution

sequences.query: (((process_path = RGX("\\\\NSudo\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\NSudoLC\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\NSudoLG\\\.exe$")) OR (process_original_file_name = "NSudo\.exe" OR process_original_file_name = "NSudoLC\.exe" OR process_original_file_name = "NSudoLG\.exe")) AND (process_command_line = RGX(".*\\-U\\:S\\ .*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\-U\\:T\\ .*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\-U\\:E\\ .*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\-P\\:E\\ .*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\-M\\:S\\ .*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\-M\\:H\\ .*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\-U\\=S\\ .*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\-U\\=T\\ .*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\-U\\=E\\ .*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\-P\\=E\\ .*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\-M\\=S\\ .*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\-M\\=H\\ .*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\-ShowWindowMode\\:Hide.*")))
